newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria central bank confirms will cut main rate.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria central bank confirms will cut main rate.

text.p: The Bulgarian National Bank (BNB) on Thursday confirmed it will cut its main interest rate to 35.76 percent annually from 47.28 percent, from Monday.
"The BNB board sets the main interest rate at 35.76 percent annually...to go in force from June 16," the BNB said in a statement. The cut was reported earlier by local bank dealers.
The BNB said the new main rate would give 42.24 percent effective annual interest rate calculated through accumulation of monthly accruals, down from the current 59.00 percent.
The new rate reflected falling yields on the Finance ministry's four-week discount T-bills this week.
The BNB adjusts the rate weekly to the weighted average effective monthly yield on four-week maturities auctioned daily from Friday through Thursday.

Yields to maturity on the T-bills auctioned since Friday ranged between 1.70-3.35 percent against 3.48-3.81 percent in the previous five days, a Finance Ministry official said. -- Sofia Newsroom, (++359-2) 911 88
